key_results: First digital-quantum-computer observation of log-law entanglement entropy scaling at criticality; MERA represents infinite systems with few qubits; revealed entanglement evolution across critical point
comments: MERA's efficiency is remarkable but success depends critically on proper lattice geometry and symmetric state preparation.

model_io.model: MERA-based subsystem tomography on trapped-ion QC

hypotheses.hypothesis: MERA efficiently represents long-range correlations at criticality
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated log-law entanglement scaling with few qubits

title: Nematic and chiral superconductivity emerging within the loop-current phase in kagome metals
task: Explain nematic chiral d-wave superconductivity in kagome metals
key_results: Loop-current order induces chiral d-wave superconductivity; dilute impurities suppress chirality and restore s-wave phase; predicts 2×2 pair-density modulation
comments: Theory elegantly explains exotic superconductivity in AV₃Sb₅ but requires experimental verification of predicted modulation patterns.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Loop-current-induced orbital magnetization stabilizes chirality
hypotheses.result: Confirmed by theoretical mechanism for both attractive and repulsive pairing

title: Competitive resource allocation drives asynchronous and rapid nuclear multiplication in the malaria parasite
task: Elucidate asynchronous nuclear multiplication in malaria parasite via competitive resource allocation
key_results: Nuclear cycles desynchronize rapidly via protein competition for DNA replication; sequential allocation to individual nuclei explains observations; asynchronous cycles accelerate proliferation by minimizing resource idling; proliferation rate ~20 parasites/2 days
comments: Elegant resource-competition model explains counterintuitive asynchrony but biological validation of claimed sequential protein allocation mechanism remains incomplete.

model_io.model: Biophysical model of shared cytoplasm nuclear replication

hypotheses.hypothesis: Protein competition drives sequential resource allocation and nuclear desynchrony
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via live-cell imaging and model comparison

title: Nonvolatile nematic order manipulated by strain and magnetic field in a layered antiferromagnet
task: Demonstrate switchable electronic nematicity manipulated by strain and magnetic field
key_results: CoTa₃S₆ exhibits resistivity anisotropy and optical birefringence nematicity; non-volatile magnetic memory effect; out-of-plane field restores C₃ symmetry; van Hove singularity origin hypothesized
comments: Clear experimental demonstration but mechanism involving van Hove singularities requires theoretical confirmation via band structure calculations.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Electronic nematicity emerges from van Hove singularity instabilities
hypotheses.result: Proposed based on observed phase diagram interplay with spin orders

title: Experimental realization of a bidirectional quantum analog-to-digital converter between photonic wavefront and qubits
task: Develop bidirectional quantum analog-to-digital converter for CV-DV hybrid systems
key_results: Deterministic QADC/QDAC with exponentially decreasing error; high-fidelity CV mode tomography via DV techniques; non-Gaussian state generation from qubits
comments: Hardware-efficient approach successfully bridges CV-DV gap, though scaling to many qubits for continuous variables requires further validation.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Error decreases exponentially with qubit number
hypotheses.result: Confirmed experimentally for deterministic information transfer

title: Microfluidic pulse oscillator enabled by a shapeshifting liquid metal capacitor
task: Design microfluidic pulse oscillator with reconfigurable liquid-metal capacitor
key_results: Monolayer oscillator achieves frequency-tunable particle focusing and separation; vortex flow in near-field, oscillatory flow in far-field; operates in AC fields via Marangoni coupling
comments: Novel liquid-metal capacitor concept enables real-time flow control but requires robust encapsulation for practical lab-on-chip integration.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Interfacial energy storage enables frequency-tunable oscillation
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated via interplay between LM capacitance and Marangoni flow

title: Hybrid metal-semiconductor quantum dots in InAs as a platform for quantum simulation
task: Demonstrate hybrid metal-semiconductor quantum dots as scalable quantum simulator platform
key_results: Metal component provides quasi-continuous electronic spectrum enabling site uniformity; semiconductor retains gate-tunable coupling; weak-coupling limit yields uniform Coulomb peaks; realistic array design proposed for many-body physics
comments: Hybrid architecture elegantly solves site-inhomogeneity problem but demonstration limited to single dots; scalability to arrays remains experimental challenge.

model_io.model: Hybrid metal-semiconductor dot in InAs QW

hypotheses.hypothesis: Metallic quasi-continuum enables electronic uniformity across array sites
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated via highly-uniform Coulomb peaks in weak-coupling regime

title: Exciton–phonon coupling in two-dimensional materials: from phenomena to applications
task: Review exciton–phonon coupling phenomena and applications in 2D materials
key_results: Enhanced exciton-phonon coupling in 2D due to reduced screening; phonon-assisted upconversion, self-trapping, dark-exciton processes documented; emerging applications in laser cooling and single-photon sources
comments: Comprehensive review synthesizes experimental and theoretical work but lacks unified theoretical framework for coupling strength prediction across materials.

title: Dynamic electron radiation belt at Mercury controlled by solar wind driving
task: Characterize dynamic electron radiation belt at Mercury controlled by solar wind forcing
key_results: Structured radiation belt persists for several Earth days under weak solar wind; bifurcates under strong driving with rapid particle loss; Lorentz drift orbits diverge about magnetic equator; Mercury as natural lab for extreme radiation-belt physics
comments: Novel MESSENGER data reanalysis reveals Mercury's radiation belt but understanding of loss mechanisms requires more detailed particle-tracing studies.

model_io.model: Mercury magnetosphere particle tracing + solar wind coupling

hypotheses.hypothesis: Strong solar wind driving causes electron drift bifurcation and rapid loss
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated via particle simulations and MESSENGER data interpretation

title: Topological phase transitions and mixed-state order in a Hubbard quantum simulator
task: Detect topological phase transition in 1D SPT phases using quantum simulator
key_results: Identified critical point via string order parameters; demonstrated group structure invertibility; revealed mixed-state order emerging from symmetry-breaking disorder
comments: First experimental observation of SPT criticality with disorder-dependent topology, bridging topology and information in quantum phase transitions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Stacking two identical systems eliminates SPT transition
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; demonstrates predicted group structure of SPT phases

title: Key trends in laser induced plasma structure revealed by longitudinally resolved optical diffractometry
task: Characterize laser-induced plasma longitudinal evolution via optical diffractometry
key_results: Supergaussian density model captures plasma evolution; identified escape position, turning point, refocusing behavior; quadratic Kerr contribution negligible in tight-focusing regime
comments: Supergaussian framework unifies conventional models but applicability limited to moderate focusing and low-power regimes.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Supergaussian model describes transverse shape evolution
hypotheses.result: Captures recurring dynamical features across multiple intensities

title: Modeling ultrafast laser excitation of fused silica with a hybrid Lorentz–Drude dielectric response and density-dependent two-temperature model
task: Model ultrafast laser excitation of fused silica via hybrid Lorentz-Drude formalism and density-dependent two-temperature model
key_results: Hybrid Lorentz-Drude optical response captures bound/free electronic states; ablation thresholds reproduced fs-ps regime; lateral extent deviations appear ps regime; melt-mediated redistribution unmodeled for >ps durations
comments: Framework effectively bridges non-equilibrium and thermal regimes but systematic deviation at longer pulses indicates need for hydrodynamic corrections.

model_io.model: Coupled Lorentz-Drude optics + density-dependent 2T thermal model

hypotheses.hypothesis: Density-dependent thermal parameters capture non-equilibrium effects
hypotheses.result: Confirmed in fs-ps regime; deviations at longer pulses indicate melt-flow importance

title: Analytical solitons, phase-space dynamics, and stability analysis in Katugampola fractional nonlinear telegraph equation
task: Solve Katugampola fractional nonlinear telegraph equation via hybrid Riccati-Bernoulli method
key_results: Three families of exact analytical solutions including kink solitons; fractional order α<1 improves wave dispersion stability; MLE analysis reveals chaotic-to-periodic transition; Hamiltonian energy analysis validates conservation
comments: Comprehensive analytical-numerical framework is thorough but boundary condition specificity and computational cost for extreme α limit practical applicability.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Decreasing α improves dispersion stability and alters wave shape
hypotheses.result: Confirmed via 2D/3D spatiotemporal profile analysis

title: Hydrodynamic characteristics during floating and installation of high blockage-ratio immersed tunnels in Inland Rivers
task: Characterize hydrodynamics of high-blockage-ratio immersed tunnel installation in rivers
key_results: CFD analysis reveals pressure ~0.24 MPa at final seating; foundation trench reduces near-trench velocity >90%; drag force maximum (1.91×10⁵ N) at river center; 77.3% drag reduction during lowering
comments: Comprehensive 3D CFD study provides practical guidance for similar projects but localized phenomena like water squeezing may require finer mesh resolution.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Foundation trench excavation creates low-velocity shielding zone
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; velocity reduction >90% relative to incoming flow

title: Synergy and reciprocity between Brillouin and Mie scattering by the presence of silver nanoparticles in the stimulated Brillouin scattering cell
task: Investigate synergy between stimulated Brillouin and Mie scattering with Ag nanoparticles
key_results: Ag nanoparticles form acoustic Bragg grating via dipole force; single hybrid SBMS process emerges; maximum reflectivity energy constant across concentrations; colloidal medium acts as tunable effective material
comments: Hybrid SBMS mechanism is novel but confinement to low Ag concentration limits practical applicability and two-photon absorption effects at high energies.

hypotheses.hypothesis: NPs and SBS-induced grating synergize via coherent Mie scattering
hypotheses.result: Confirmed; single SBMS process dominates over independent SMS+SBS

title: Integrated value iteration and simple games enable calibrated strategic coalition formation in social networks
task: Optimize influencer coalition formation via value iteration and cooperative game theory
key_results: Deterministic MDP with simple-game rewards finds minimal winning coalitions; fixed-order greedy construction ensures exact marginal reach; local search refines to local optimum; NP-hardness established
comments: Bridging planning algorithms and cooperative game theory is novel but practical applicability depends on accurate pre-computed influencer ordering.

model_io.model: Value iteration MDP + simple game characteristic function

hypotheses.hypothesis: Fixed-order greedy construction eliminates calibration burden
hypotheses.result: Proven; marginal reach values exact by construction

title: Deep learning-enhanced graphene metasurface terahertz absorber for real-time multi-gas identification and quantification
task: Simultaneously identify and quantify four hazardous gases using graphene metasurface and deep learning
key_results: Multi-task CNN achieves F1>0.97 classification and 8.9 ppm MAE regression; sub-second response; 0.35–0.90 eV bias switching enables multi-dimensional sensing
comments: Synthetic-only training and lack of experimental validation limit practical deployment; Langmuir isotherm may oversimplify real adsorption kinetics.

model_io.model: Graphene metasurface THz absorber + multi-task CNN

hypotheses.hypothesis: Voltage-switching generates multi-dimensional feature space for selectivity
hypotheses.result: Demonstrated via F1>0.97 multi-label classification

title: Integrated fiberized diamond magnetometer with high sensitivity and dynamic range by magnetic flux concentrators
task: Develop high-sensitivity integrated fiberized diamond magnetometer with flux concentrators
key_results: 50 pT/√Hz@0.01 Hz and 390 fT/√Hz@>3 Hz sensitivity; 4× Earth's magnetic field dynamic range; [111]-oriented diamond between MFCs with optimized laser polarization
comments: Excellent sensitivity-dynamic-range trade-off achieved but portability claims require demonstration in realistic field conditions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Perpendicular pump laser polarization enhances SNR linearity
hypotheses.result: Confirmed experimentally via dual-MFC sandwich geometry

title: Characterizing Pauli propagation via operator complexity
task: Quantify resource cost of Pauli-propagation simulations via operator complexity
key_results: Truncation error governed by Operator Stabilizer Rényi entropy; quadratic growth of Pauli coefficients for 1D Heisenberg at Jz=0; competitive with TDVP in interacting regime
comments: Elegant connection between operator complexity theory and practical truncation budgets, though applicability limited to specific Heisenberg models tested.

hypotheses.hypothesis: OSE controls compressibility of evolving operators
hypotheses.result: Proven bounds relate OSE to Top-K budget requirements
